issue.title: replace tool turns literal Rust CRLF escapes into control characters

steps: Create http.rs with exactly this one-line Rust source and a final newline: fn main() { let x = b"old"; }. Read it with read_file.
expected: Exact replacement preserves literal source-code escape sequences after JSON decoding.
defect: replace writes physical newline/CR control characters where new_string contained literal backslash escape sequences, corrupting source code.
Root cause: The observed behavior is consistent with an additional escape-normalization step after JSON decoding, which makes literal backslash-n indistinguishable from an actual newline. The reports do not identify a confirmed implementation line; do not label an arbitrary edit helper as the root cause.
